table.name: Country
table.purpose: Lookup table of countries (11 rows), each hosting a football league in the database. Referenced by League and Match. This is the European soccer database schema (Country/League/Match/Player/Team).

id.name: country_id
id.description: Primary key identifying a country. Values are opaque numeric ids (e.g. 1729=England, 7809=Germany, 24558=Switzerland) shared with League.id, which uses the same id per country's league. Referenced by Match.country_id, Match.league_id and League.country_id.

name.name: country_name
name.description: Name of the country (e.g. England, Germany, Portugal, Switzerland). Unique across the 11 rows.

table.name: League
table.purpose: Lookup table of football (soccer) leagues/countries; one row per league, 11 European leagues. The league id mirrors the country id (each country has one league in this dataset). Referenced by Match to classify matches by league and country.

country_id.name: country_id
country_id.description: Foreign key to Country.id identifying the country the league belongs to (e.g. 1729 = England, 24558 = Switzerland). One-to-one with Country; in this dataset it equals the league id.

id.name: league_id
id.description: Primary key of the league; referenced by Match.league_id. Values coincide with country_id because each country in this dataset has exactly one league.

name.name: league_name
name.description: Full name of the league, prefixed by country (e.g. 'England Premier League', 'Germany 1. Bundesliga').

table.name: Match
table.purpose: One row per professional soccer (football) match: teams, date, league/season/stage, final score, lineups with formation coordinates, per-bookmaker 1X2 betting odds, and XML event data (goals, cards, corners, etc.). This is the Match table of the well-known European Soccer Database.

table.name: Player
table.purpose: One row per football (soccer) player: biographical data (name, birthday, height, weight) plus two external API identifiers used to link to player attribute ratings and match lineups. Part of a European football database (with Country, League, Match, Team, etc.).

birthday.name: birth_date
birthday.description: Player's date of birth (dates 1967-1999, consistent with professional players active in the 2000s-2010s).

height.name: height_cm
height.description: Player's height in centimeters (range 157.48-208.28; values like 182.88 = 6 ft exactly, suggesting conversion from imperial source data).

id.name: player_id
id.description: Surrogate primary key for the Player table (sequential 1-11075, unique, no joins).

player_api_id.name: player_api_id
player_api_id.description: External API identifier for the player; referenced by Player_Attributes and by the home_player_X / away_player_X lineup columns in Match.

player_fifa_api_id.name: player_fifa_api_id
player_fifa_api_id.description: FIFA (EA Sports / game data) identifier for the player; referenced by Player_Attributes.player_fifa_api_id.

player_name.name: player_name
player_name.description: Player's full name (mostly unique; duplicates like 'Danilo', 'Paulinho' are common Brazilian names of different players).

weight.name: weight_lbs
weight.description: Player's weight in pounds (range 117-243, mean ~168; plausible for pounds, not kilograms — kg values would be ~75-110).

table.name: Player_Attributes
table.purpose: FIFA/EA Sports-style football (soccer) player skill ratings: one row per player per rating update date, with ~40 attributes on a 1-99 scale plus overall rating, potential, preferred foot and work rates. Links to Player via player_api_id and player_fifa_api_id.

attacking_work_rate.name: attacking_work_rate
attacking_work_rate.description: Attacking work rate: low/medium/high. Contains dirty values ('None', 'norm', 'stoc', 'le') indicating data-quality issues.

date.name: rating_date
date.description: Date the attribute snapshot was recorded (FIFA version update date), 2007-02-22 to 2016-07-07.

defensive_work_rate.name: defensive_work_rate
defensive_work_rate.description: Defensive work rate: low/medium/high. Heavily polluted with junk values ('_0', 'o', '2', '9', 'es', '7').

gk_diving.name: gk_diving
gk_diving.description: Goalkeeper diving rating, 1-99 scale; very low for most rows because most players are not goalkeepers.

gk_handling.name: gk_handling
gk_handling.description: Goalkeeper handling rating, 1-99 scale; low for non-goalkeepers.

gk_kicking.name: gk_kicking
gk_kicking.description: Goalkeeper kicking rating, 1-99 scale; low for non-goalkeepers.

gk_positioning.name: gk_positioning
gk_positioning.description: Goalkeeper positioning rating, 1-99 scale; low for non-goalkeepers.

gk_reflexes.name: gk_reflexes
gk_reflexes.description: Goalkeeper reflexes rating, 1-99 scale; low for non-goalkeepers.

id.name: id
id.description: Surrogate primary key for this attribute snapshot row.

overall_rating.name: overall_rating
overall_rating.description: Overall player rating, 33-94, the headline FIFA rating.

player_api_id.name: player_api_id
player_api_id.description: Foreign key to Player.player_api_id; identifies the player this snapshot belongs to.

player_fifa_api_id.name: player_fifa_api_id
player_fifa_api_id.description: Foreign key to Player.player_fifa_api_id; the player's FIFA/EA identifier.

potential.name: potential
potential.description: Potential rating (maximum attainable overall rating), 39-97; always >= overall_rating.

table.name: Team
table.purpose: Reference/dimension table of football (soccer) teams, one row per team, linking internal ids to external API ids and FIFA ids, with long and short team names. Referenced by Match (home/away team) and Team_Attributes via team_api_id.

id.name: id
id.description: Internal surrogate primary key for the team row; unique integer with no external meaning.

team_api_id.name: team_api_id
team_api_id.description: External team identifier from the data provider API (used by Match.home_team_api_id, Match.away_team_api_id and Team_Attributes.team_api_id as foreign key).

team_fifa_api_id.name: team_fifa_api_id
team_fifa_api_id.description: Team identifier in the EA Sports FIFA game dataset; unique except for a few duplicates, null for ~4% of teams not present in FIFA data.

team_long_name.name: team_long_name
team_long_name.description: Full official team name (e.g. 'Villarreal CF', '1. FC Köln'); a few names appear twice, likely distinct clubs sharing a name across countries/eras.

team_short_name.name: team_short_name
team_short_name.description: Three-letter abbreviation of the team name (e.g. 'SIE' for Siena, 'HIB' for Hibernian); not unique, shared by multiple clubs.

table.name: Team_Attributes
table.purpose: Periodic snapshots of team tactical/playing-style ratings (FIFA-style attributes) per team, covering build-up play, chance creation and defence, recorded at six dates from 2010 to 2015. Each row is one team's attribute set at one date; joins to Team via team_api_id (European soccer database).

buildUpPlayDribbling.name: buildUpPlayDribbling
buildUpPlayDribbling.description: Rating (20-77) of how much the team dribbles during build-up play; higher = more dribbling. 66.5% null (not recorded in earlier snapshots).

buildUpPlayDribblingClass.name: buildUpPlayDribblingClass
buildUpPlayDribblingClass.description: Categorical band of build-up dribbling: Little / Normal / Lots.

buildUpPlayPassing.name: buildUpPlayPassing
buildUpPlayPassing.description: Rating (20-80) of passing in build-up play; higher = more/longer passing emphasis.

buildUpPlayPassingClass.name: buildUpPlayPassingClass
buildUpPlayPassingClass.description: Categorical band of build-up passing: Short / Mixed / Long.

buildUpPlayPositioningClass.name: buildUpPlayPositioningClass
buildUpPlayPositioningClass.description: Build-up positioning style: Organised or Free Form.

buildUpPlaySpeed.name: buildUpPlaySpeed
buildUpPlaySpeed.description: Rating (20-80) of build-up play speed; higher = faster build-up.

buildUpPlaySpeedClass.name: buildUpPlaySpeedClass
buildUpPlaySpeedClass.description: Categorical band of build-up speed: Slow / Balanced / Fast.

chanceCreationCrossing.name: chanceCreationCrossing
chanceCreationCrossing.description: Rating (20-80) of crossing tendency in chance creation; higher = more crosses.

chanceCreationCrossingClass.name: chanceCreationCrossingClass
chanceCreationCrossingClass.description: Categorical band of crossing in chance creation: Little / Normal / Lots.

chanceCreationPassing.name: chanceCreationPassing
chanceCreationPassing.description: Rating (21-80) of passing in chance creation; higher = more passing-oriented chance creation.

chanceCreationPassingClass.name: chanceCreationPassingClass
chanceCreationPassingClass.description: Categorical band of chance-creation passing: Safe / Normal / Risky.

chanceCreationPositioningClass.name: chanceCreationPositioningClass
chanceCreationPositioningClass.description: Chance-creation positioning style: Organised or Free Form.

chanceCreationShooting.name: chanceCreationShooting
chanceCreationShooting.description: Rating (22-80) of shooting tendency in chance creation; higher = more shots.

chanceCreationShootingClass.name: chanceCreationShootingClass
chanceCreationShootingClass.description: Categorical band of shooting in chance creation: Little / Normal / Lots.

date.name: date
date.description: Snapshot date of the team attributes; six distinct dates (2010-02-22 to 2015-09-10), roughly twice yearly.

defenceAggression.name: defenceAggression
defenceAggression.description: Rating (24-72) of defensive aggression; higher = more aggressive defending.

defenceAggressionClass.name: defenceAggressionClass
defenceAggressionClass.description: Defensive aggression style: Contain / Press / Double (team).

defenceDefenderLineClass.name: defenceDefenderLineClass
defenceDefenderLineClass.description: Defensive line behaviour: Cover or Offside Trap.

defencePressure.name: defencePressure
defencePressure.description: Rating (23-72) of defensive pressure; higher = higher defensive line/pressing intensity.

defencePressureClass.name: defencePressureClass
defencePressureClass.description: Categorical band of defensive pressure: Deep / Medium / High.

defenceTeamWidth.name: defenceTeamWidth
defenceTeamWidth.description: Rating (29-73) of defensive team width; higher = wider defensive shape.

defenceTeamWidthClass.name: defenceTeamWidthClass
defenceTeamWidthClass.description: Categorical band of defensive width: Narrow / Normal / Wide.

id.name: id
id.description: Primary key; surrogate row identifier (1-1458, one per team-snapshot).

team_api_id.name: team_api_id
team_api_id.description: Foreign key to Team.team_api_id; external API identifier of the team. 288 teams, up to 6 snapshots each.

team_fifa_api_id.name: team_fifa_api_id
team_fifa_api_id.description: FIFA (game) API identifier of the team; likely also present in Team table but no accepted join detected here.
